purpose: A: measure pre-outcome (deployable) headroom H_pre directly with known p, separating foresight from selection gap
B: compare DC-PRISM against random, uncertainty, BAIT-style and target-variance greedy baselines on an ex-ante endpoint
C: one-at-a-time sensitivity of DC-PRISM constants (descriptive)
D: online delayed replay with the new baselines on the original engineered stream and on a natural random stream
development: execution smoke tests used seeds 99001-99002 only; no study seed was run before this freeze; no constant was changed after smoke tests

offline.states: Controlled: 128 worlds; Real-X: 4 cells x 64 pairs x {broad, gap} history arms (supplement-v2 construction); 9 analysis groups
offline.endpoint: ex-ante expected Brier E_Y[L_p(S;Y)]: test-label noise integrated exactly with known p_T; hidden O and C training labels resampled from known p (128 shared draws per state)
offline.family: common family of supplement-v2 (risk/family frozen on broad history) union all main-policy choices; contains anchor M_K
offline.H_pre_estimators: plug-in (upward biased) and two-fold cross-fitted on even/odd resamples (downward biased); foresight_lb = H_post - H_pre_plugin
offline.sensitivity: package DC-PRISM; one constant at a time: quantile {0.1,0.3,0.5}, penalty {0,0.11,0.44}, gate {0,0.04,0.16}, damping {0,0.9}, tanh scale {1.25,5}; descriptive 95% pointwise intervals, no tests

online.metric: ALC-Brier: mean of 10 round-start Brier scores (S delay 1, O delay 2), identical to p4-confirmation-v1
online.reproduce_check: inherited 5 policies on archived seeds 21001 and 21016 must match p4-confirmation-v1 ALC to 1e-12 before the study runs

inference.method: paired one-sample t on independent units; Bonferroni simultaneous t intervals and global Holm within each registered family

stopping: fixed sizes; no interim significance looks; no additional seeds after results
limitations: Real-X labels are generated from known p on real covariates; not real outcomes
natural stream still uses fixed processed cohorts and random (not calendar) order
BAIT-Greedy is a forward-only adaptation under the envelope, not the full original BAIT
TargetVar-Greedy is an EPIG-style Laplace approximation, not sampling-based EPIG
